description: This file defines an interface for parsing and representing Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) within the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies methods for parsing ARN strings, converting ARN objects to strings or arrays, and retrieving ARN components such as partition, service, region, account ID, and resource.

classes.name: ArnInterface
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for parsing, representing, and accessing components of an Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into an ARN object representation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ARN.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the prefix of the ARN.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Retrieves the partition component of the ARN.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the service component of the ARN.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the region component of the ARN.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves the resource component of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the ARN object into an associative array of its components.
